rationale: TSM has gapped down 3.45% on 5.71x relative volume with earnings tomorrow, creating extreme uncertainty about direction — the stock is trading near the low of today's range (25.8%) but the 9-EMA is significantly above at $415.84, suggesting downward momentum. The pre-earnings environment with elevated VIXY (+2.39%) and broad market weakness makes both long and short entries high-risk: a long risks further gap-fill selling while a short risks a violent reversal on any positive earnings leak or market stabilization. The risk/reward is insufficiently defined to commit capital.
